basic_profile.bio: Hello! I'm a 28-year-old university student studying psychology, living in Portland, Oregon. My interests include exploring the human mind, photography, and finding new hiking trails. I’m quite new to Reddit but I’m loving the community so far. Typically, I’m online in the evenings after classes or during the weekends when I’m not out with friends. As for my job, I'm a part-time barista at a local coffee shop. Currently single, I enjoy engaging in thoughtful discussions and learning from others' experiences.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge mainly stems from my psychology studies, where I've learned about human behavior and mental health. I also pick up a lot through personal experiences and online resources. I’m particularly interested in how medications interact with mental health conditions.
